bear_assumptions: Low-end USD 7.10 adjusted EPS at 20x; Pratt remediation, fixed-price execution, supply, or cycle pressure prevents further normalization and compresses the premium multiple.
base_assumptions: USD 7.175 adjusted EPS guidance midpoint at 25x; backlog converts and raised cash guidance is delivered, but leverage, remediation, and cycle risks retain a discount to the current multiple.
bull_assumptions: High-end USD 7.25 adjusted EPS at 34x; defense and commercial demand convert cleanly, margins and cash strengthen, and remediation and execution risks recede enough to sustain a premium multiple.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if fresh scenarios clear the expected-return, base-return, payoff-asymmetry, margin-of-safety, confidence, and relationship gates; downgrade further if fixed-price losses, Pratt liabilities, leverage, supply constraints, award delays, commercial demand, or cash-flow delivery deteriorate.
